name: ActiView (all 1,625 instances: zooming + shifting R/E/M/H)

assignment.task: Official ActiView (active perception VQA). Each request is one official step: either a perception decision (which image parts to zoom into, or whether more visual information is needed) or the final multiple-choice answer. Follow the instruction text of the request exactly; the reply text is parsed by the official ActiView parser.
assignment.observation: The official request: the image(s) shown at this step followed by the official prompt text.

actions.action: The reply text for this step, in the format the request asks for.

assignment.evaluation: Official ActiView accuracy per setting (zooming; shifting R, E, M, H).

tool.name: submit_action
tool.description: Submit the reply text for this step.

contract: One reply text per request, in the format the request asks for.

player.invalidResponses: H0 used structured output (one schema-valid submit_action per response); a refusal or a response without an action was retried with the same request, without a reprompt.
